name: REV-INR
definition: A method that replaces multiple models with a single SIREN whose final layer outputs four parameters of a Normal Inverse-Gamma distribution for closed-form estimation of epistemic and aleatoric uncertainty.
summary: REV-INR is a single SIREN network that estimates epistemic and aleatoric uncertainty via closed-form distribution parameters, offering ensemble-level accuracy with deterministic inference speed and lower storage costs.
